title: InstantTeleport
description: InstantTeleport adds a rechargeable teleportation device with saved destinations and quick slot-based teleporting.
body:
![device panel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/efee995f4deb8ea76496e2c0cc14a25c8a70456f.png)  InstantTeleport is a NeoForge mod for Minecraft 26.1.2 that adds a compact teleportation device for saving and returning to locations.

  Features:

  - Save up to 9 teleport destinations
  - Rename or remove saved destinations from a simple right-click editor
  - Use Alt + 1 through Alt + 9 to teleport to saved slots
  - Rechargeable FE-based teleportation
  - English and Turkish language support

  This is a beta release for Minecraft 26.1.2 and NeoForge 26.1.2.63-beta.
